items.title: Richard McLean Interview, 1959-05-27
items.q: I went to John Morell... I asked him to teach me, he said, well, sure, I'll teach you.

ctx.x: I forgot to ask you, when you learned to read music, did you work that out by yourself? Or some of these people helped you, like, uh, the guitar? Well, that's something I forgot.

That was one thing I forgot to tell you. Well, I first, you see, when I first started playing with him, I was just playing by ear, what's it called. Well, after I began to play with these bands, some of these bands used to use music, you see. And playing with those bands, they would play pieces that, I mean, my ear just wasn't good enough to catch the chords, you see. So, uh, uh, I said, well, I'm gonna try to learn something about the music anyhow, so I'll be able to make the right chords. So, I went to John…
Was he with Celestan in those days, I guess? Who's that? Was he with Celestan?
